messages:
maria: Postmortem is up for the 3/9 latency incident. We need to lock down action owners for SLO & dashboard follow-ups. Summary: recurring cold-start tail latency on embedding-service; caused multiple throttled retrains and a ~35m elevated p99.

taylor: Thanks. I'll own SLO proposals. Planning to add a P99 SLO for /v1/embeddings and tighten error-budget burn alert. ETA EOD Thu. @arpit can you add dashboard panels?

arpit: On it. Will add per-model latency heatmap and per-deployment error budget graph. ETA tomorrow morning. Need the Prometheus queries?

maria: P99 query here: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))` and error budget calc: `sum(rate(errors_total[1h])) / sum(rate(requests_total[1h]))`. Add alert when error_budget < 20% over 6h.

kai: Also propose enabling soft-warmup pooling for cold starts; that'll be a separate remediation ticket. I can own that, ETA 2 weeks.

jess: I've created PROD-2345 for SLO changes + dashboards. Linked the postmortem. @taylor @arpit please add to the ticket with checkboxes.

taylor: Updated PROD-2345 with proposed SLOs: p95 120ms, p99 450ms for embeddings, throughput SLO: >=95% success rate for 99.9% of time windows. Adding rollback policy and a canary for the SLO change. :white_check_mark:

arpit: Drafted dashboard panels and an alert rule; pasting the alert snippet for review:

```
alert: EmbeddingServiceErrorBudgetLow
expr: (sum(rate(errors_total[1h])) / sum(rate(requests_total[1h]))) > 0.2
for: 30m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Embedding service error budget < 20%"
```

Will push as PR to infra-dashboards and link to PROD-2345.

maria: Agree on the alert for paging. For lower noise require two clusters to agree and keep `for: 30m`. Also add a slack webhook to #incidents and include runbook link in annotation.

taylor: I'll review the dashboard PR and land SLO change if no objections. Who's owning the runbook update?

kai: I'll update the runbook and add a 'cold-start mitigation' play (soft-warmup, pooling, cache prefill). ETA next Wednesday.

jess: Oncall tests: can someone add a synthetic check for tail latency during ramp periods? I can schedule daily smoke tests once it's added.

arpit: Adding synthetic to the dashboard and will wire in onboarding docs. Will attach screenshots to the PR.

maria: Great. Action items recap:
- SLO proposal + PR: taylor (EOD Thu, link: PROD-2345)
- Dashboard + alert PR: arpit (tomorrow AM, link: PROD-2345)
- Runbook + mitigation writeup: kai (next Wed)
- Cold-start mitigation ticket & implementation: kai (2w)
- Synthetic smoke tests: jess (schedule)

We'll reconvene in 7 days for a follow-up check. :eyes:

incident-bot: Reminder: follow-up check-in scheduled in 7 days for PROD-2345.
